high_level_description: The image depicts a scene inside a retail store, specifically the beauty section. The setting appears to be a well-lit, modern store with shelves stocked with various beauty products. The products include nail polishes, perfumes, and other cosmetics, neatly arranged on white shelves. In the foreground, three women are engaged in shopping. One woman is wearing a red dress with yellow pants and carrying a black shoulder bag. Another woman is dressed in a purple floral skirt and a dark top, holding a yellow handbag.
